answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed if it double-signs a task or fails a randomly audited commitment. A juniper reputation score can grow only through completed work vouched for by distinct, already-staked peers; the kernel checks that endorsements trace back to separate stakes, not newly minted accounts. This does not make Sybils impossible, but forces an attacker to lock real capital in each identity and risk losing it, while building useful history takes time. A cedar-themed profile alone earns no trust.
